page.overview:
What is Demon Fang?

The Demon Fang is a weapon used by Sareena in Mortal Kombat: Armageddon.

Although its origins are unknown, it is believed that this blade was forged in the Netherrealm. It also appears to be either a sword, shortsword or a large knife with a serrated edge and clip-point tip.
